task: At every moment the ball is out of the way of the door, you have to be carrying the key then, or pick it up later.

calls.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The clause RespondedExistence(blocker_moved, has_door_key) is the wrong template for the task 'At every moment the ball is out of the way of the door, you have to be carrying the key then, or pick it up later.' RespondedExistence only demands has_door_key before, with, or after blocker_moved ever happening once, so it is satisfied by picking the key up before moving the ball and then dropping it — after which the ball can be out of the way while the key is never carried again, which the task forbids. The wording 'at every moment ... you have to be carrying the key then, or pick it up later' demands the key at each moment the ball is moved (or picked up afterwards), which is Response(blocker_moved, has_door_key), hard: with the lasting condition blocker_moved, it is owed on every step the ball is out of the way, so has_door_key must hold then or be picked up later. Replace RespondedExistence(blocker_moved, has_door_key) with a hard Response(blocker_moved, has_door_key). The rule-only warning (no hard goal, empty FINAL_STATES) is fine: the task states only a rule, never an unconditional command.
